qa_pairs.instruction: What change occurs to the driver icon when the Bidirectional eDirectory driver is imported into Designer?
qa_pairs.output: When the Bidirectional eDirectory driver is imported into Designer, the driver icon changes to the legacy eDirectory driver icon.

qa_pairs.instruction: Why does the driver icon show the legacy eDirectory driver icon after importing the Bidirectional eDirectory driver into Designer?
qa_pairs.output: The icon change is expected behavior: importing the Bidirectional eDirectory driver causes its icon to be replaced by the legacy eDirectory driver icon, as documented for this driver.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the effect on the driver icon when the Bidirectional eDirectory driver is imported into Designer.
qa_pairs.output: Importing the Bidirectional eDirectory driver into Designer changes its displayed icon to the legacy eDirectory driver icon.
